info.title: Vega API
info.description:
Backend for the Vega service-booking apps (customer, vendor, service boy, admin).

**Authenticate:** call `POST /auth/login` (or `/auth/google`), copy `token`, click **Authorize** and paste it.

Success responses are plain JSON bodies. Errors are always `{ message, code, errors? }`.
